infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Allow Nouriva AI to use Face ID to protect your account on this device.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Nouriva AI reads steps, heart rate, sleep, and weight from Apple Health to contextualize how meals fit your day.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Nouriva AI saves the nutrition data of meals you log (calories, macros, water) to Apple Health when you choose to sync.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow Nouriva AI to use your camera to scan meals and food labels, and to take a profile photo.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow Nouriva AI to access your photos to analyse meal pictures, upload lab reports, and set a profile picture.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow Nouriva AI to use your microphone so you can log meals by voice.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Allow Nouriva AI to transcribe what you say when logging meals by voice.
